item.tib: stag ri rong gi las sa bsen mnan pa'i ti ka
item.coloph: dang po gshen rab ston pas mdzad/ bar du stong rgyung mthu chen las/ de nas khod spungs bdag gis gab pa dkrol te gter du sbas/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don byed par shog u ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dpon gsas gyis gter zhal phyes de/ (te/)rim gyis brgyud stag btsun stag lha rgyal mtshan/ rim gyis stag btsun nam mkha' dbang rgyal la'o//
